description: Investigators conduct investigations on Zvonarska Street, visit the renowned Eximious Bookstore, pursue archaeological clues about the Crusader's Tomb resurfacing, and Yamina reveals her connection to Professor Moric

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Glancing at Bai Lan, smoothing her hair. "I'm fine, but that young lady is a bit injured."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Out of curiosity, do we decide where to go under the guide's leadership? Will the guide protect our safety?" #Carefully picks up the document, checking for loopholes. "I'm not very proficient with a shotgun. Can the guide handle some distant prey for me sometimes?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The waiter pushes a yellowed parchment document across the counter, stamped with a raised seal of a double-headed eagle. The terms are written in two languages: "The holder must follow the instructions of the licensed guide at all times; hunting is limited to the southern slope of the Kunivich Reserve; it is forbidden to pursue wounded prey into restricted areas; the deposit will not be refunded if safety regulations are violated." He points to the third item and adds, "The guide is both protection and supervision. Last year, a count chased a wild boar across the boundary, not only lost his deposit but also faced a lawsuit from the gendarmerie."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Looking at Bai Lan's injury timidly. "Um... miss, do you need bandaging?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Of course, sir." The waiter lightly taps the supplementary clause at the end of the document. "It states here that the guide can provide assistance with shooting when necessary."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Goes outside to hail a taxi.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Alright, I'll sign." #Checks the terms once more with a pen, pays the deposit. "When I'm ready to hunt, I'll bring the shotgun here. I hope you'll be prepared." #After finishing, gets in the car, go go go!

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: (taxi!)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The taxi stops in front of a two-story hotel in the south of Węgrów. The building, serving as the local cultural center, emits faint sounds of violin practice. player8 walks through the lobby paved with Serbian traditional tapestries, her gaze sweeping over guests listening to a piano solo under the arcade. She asks the staff behind the gilded counter in German about Dr. Moric's registration. The staff checks the gold-embossed accommodation register and shakes their head. player8's fingers slightly tighten her skirt, then she softly asks if there are any letters for player8 Moric. The staff retrieves an envelope from the walnut box labeled 'Mail to be Collected'. The wax seal clearly bears the imprinted initials JM.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "This seems like a distress letter, miss." "To be honest, I really feel he has a kind of..." "A sense of entrusting something. You should prepare yourself mentally."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: "Archaeology leading to deaths?" #Looks skeptical. "Don't say such unlucky things."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Literally translated as "Zagreb's / Bell-related / King Zvonimir".

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "To be honest, there are many deaths in archaeology."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Pinching the paper, hand slightly clenching, then relaxing, supporting forehead with one hand. #Mutters quietly, "I need to find more help, need someone familiar with the ropes."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "What kind are you referring to?"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "My father's friend." #Gives Dr. Berenzada's address. "He was my father's comrade-in-arms. If there's anyone reliable here, it can only be him."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "OK, I think seeking his help first is our best course of action." "We'll have to trouble you to lead the way then." "Ugh, another taxi ride."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The investigators arrive at Dr. Berenzada's two-story house. A maid named Kamila Hannak opens the door and receives them. She explains that the doctor is currently working at Węgrów General Hospital, is rarely at home, and provides the hospital's specific location.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Thanks the maid for the information, then turns and walks towards the hospital.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The investigators push open the hospital's double wooden doors. The smell of disinfectant gently permeates the air. The hall is brightly lit, with overhead chandeliers casting steady white light. The beige walls are clean and tidy, adorned with a few landscape paintings. The polished tile floor reflects the light. Several waiting patients sit on green cushioned benches in the waiting area. Medical staff in white nurse uniforms are talking softly with medical records in hand. A bespectacled nurse behind the reception desk is organizing a filing cabinet.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Walks up to the reception desk.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Well, dear translator, please help translate this sentence for me."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Hands clasped, leaning slightly forward, asks the nurse, "Miss, is Dr. Berenzada available now?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "We're looking for this, Dr. Berenzada."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The nurse looks up from the medical record book with a professional smile. "Sorry, Dr. Berenzada is not at the hospital at the moment. His working hours are from 8:30 AM to noon." She points to the brass wall clock; the hands show it's just past 5 PM. "If you need emergency services, the doctor on duty is in examination room three. Or you can leave your contact information, and I'll ask the doctor to call back tomorrow."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I wonder if we could inquire about this gentleman's home address. This lady here is the daughter of this gentleman's friend. We have some matters to discuss with him during this time."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That's personal privacy, I cannot disclose it." The nurse maintains her professional smile.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Shows a puzzled expression.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Qiduo received! Continuing to record Bread or Stone (Węgrów 1923) for you. Currently 388 texts recorded, time elapsed 2 hours 5 minutes 11 seconds. Huh? A piece of paper flew out when opening the file. If you're bad, just practice more. If you can't handle losing, then don't play. The past is the past, the present is the present. If you always compare the past to the present, why don't you compare it to when you were born?

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: So, last time we said: The investigators were stranded in Węgrów due to the railway being blown up. Just as they were about to rest, they encountered a panicked girl seeking help. She had rushed back to her hometown after receiving an urgent letter from her father, and was followed as soon as she got off the train. After escaping danger, the investigators accompanied the girl to the hotel where they were supposed to meet, only finding a note left by her father at the front desk, with hastily written, unclear information. To find clues, they went to the hospital where the girl's father's old friend, Dr. Berenzada, worked, but learned from the staff on duty that the doctor had already left. So now you are at the hospital front desk. What do you do next?

Then he brings a plate of sausages taken from the grill with charred edges, accompanied by a side of pickled yellowing cucumbers.

conversation.text: Soon, only dark brown meat juice stains remained at the bottom of the clay pot, and only scattered pickled cucumber seeds were left on the baking tray. Empty wine bottles lay across the wooden table, the lingering aroma still hovering around their necks.

conversation.speaker: player9

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: On the north side of the intersection stood rows of gray-walled apartments. Next door, a tanner's shop had a half-finished saddle hanging at its entrance. Across the street, a grocery store's shelves were piled with tin cans and burlap sacks. Professor Bela noticed that the bookstore was the famous Eximious Bookstore. This shop specialized in rare Eastern European books and primarily provided mail-order services for scholars from various regions. Most of the books piled inside were old volumes, and she had also ordered ancient texts from this store before.
